error-message.name: error-message
error-message.description: Displays an error message with an enter/leave animation. Used standalone or by form components.

button.name: button
button.description: A button with variants, sizes, a loading state, and leading/trailing icon slots.

text-input.name: text-input
text-input.description: A text input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Angular signal forms.

password.name: password
password.description: A password input with a show/hide toggle, built on the same form integrations as text-input.

select.name: select
select.description: A listbox select with search/filter, a clear button, viewport-aware panel placement, and custom templates for the trigger, options, icon, header, and footer.

switch.name: switch
switch.description: A toggle switch supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with sm/md/lg sizes and optional on/off icons.

checkbox.name: checkbox
checkbox.description: A checkbox supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with sm/md/lg sizes and an indeterminate state.

radio-group.name: radio-group
radio-group.description: A radio group supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with the same options/optionLabel/optionValue shape as Select.

textarea.name: textarea
textarea.description: A multi-line text input supporting ngModel, reactive forms, and Signal Forms, with optional auto-resize and a character counter.
